description: Sealed records, padding and the reader checks of section 9 steps 1 and 2 (section 4).

vectors.name: record/key
vectors.description: Per-record key rk = HKDF(K_epoch, salt, "psss/v1/record").

vectors.name: record/seal-item
vectors.description: A sealed item-change record end to end: header, body (with mhead), signature, padding, record id.

vectors.name: record/open/ok
vectors.description: The record above opens (mhead is returned).

vectors.name: record/open/bad-magic
vectors.description: First byte of the magic flipped (step 1): discarded.

vectors.name: record/open/unknown-gid
vectors.description: The reader knows no group with this gid (step 1): it waits.

vectors.name: record/open/no-key-for-epoch
vectors.description: The reader holds no key for epoch 0 (step 1): it waits.

vectors.name: record/open/gid-bit-flipped
vectors.description: One bit of the gid flipped: no key for that gid (step 1): it waits.

vectors.name: record/open/bad-tag
vectors.description: Last ciphertext byte flipped (step 2): discarded.

vectors.name: record/open/salt-bit-flipped
vectors.description: One bit of the salt flipped: another record key (step 2).

vectors.name: record/open/epoch-bit-flipped
vectors.description: The epoch in the header changed to 1: no key for epoch 1, so the record waits.

vectors.name: record/open/too-short
vectors.description: Fewer than 88 bytes (header and tag).

vectors.name: record/open/padding-not-zero
vectors.description: A non-zero byte in the padding.

vectors.name: record/open/padding-not-minimal
vectors.description: Padded to a permitted size, but longer than size(n) gives.

vectors.name: record/open/size-not-permitted
vectors.description: Plaintext one byte short of a permitted size.

vectors.name: record/open/length-exceeds-plaintext
vectors.description: u32(len(body)) larger than the plaintext.

vectors.name: record/open/body-over-1mib
vectors.description: u32(len(body)) of 1 MiB + 1 in a small plaintext: refused before anything else is read.

vectors.name: record/open/body-not-deterministic
vectors.description: The version written as 18 01 instead of 01.

vectors.name: record/open/body-trailing-byte
vectors.description: One extra byte after the body map, inside the declared length.

vectors.name: record/open/body-unknown-key
vectors.description: The body carries key 11, which is not defined.

vectors.name: record/open/body-version-2
vectors.description: v is 2.

vectors.name: record/open/body-prev-with-seq-1
vectors.description: seq is 1 but prev is not null.

vectors.name: record/open/body-content-without-mhead
vectors.description: A content record (kind 16) without mhead.

vectors.name: record/open/body-mhead-not-32-bytes
vectors.description: mhead of 31 bytes.

vectors.name: record/open/body-author-short
vectors.description: author of 31 bytes.

vectors.name: record/open/body-seq-zero
vectors.description: seq 0.

vectors.name: record/open/body-clock-three-elements
vectors.description: clock with three elements.

vectors.name: record/open/body-membership-with-mhead
vectors.description: A membership record (kind 3) that carries mhead: membership records carry mprev instead.

vectors.name: record/open/bad-signature-wrong-signer
vectors.description: Body names alice as author but is signed with mallory's key.

vectors.name: record/open/bad-signature-zero
vectors.description: An all-zero signature.

vectors.name: record/open/bad-signature-s-not-reduced
vectors.description: The valid signature with S replaced by S + L: section 1.2 rejects it although the equation holds.

vectors.name: record/open/author-small-order
vectors.description: The author is the identity point and the signature is the forger's (R = identity, S = 0): the author is refused (1.2).

vectors.name: record/open/moved-header-new-salt
vectors.description: The same signed body re-sealed with another salt: the salt is not the one derived from the key and the body, so it is discarded before the signature is looked at (bad_salt, 4.1).

vectors.name: record/open/moved-header-new-epoch
vectors.description: The same signed body re-sealed into epoch 1 with the salt derived for that key: the salt matches, but the signature covers the header, so it cannot be moved to another epoch.

vectors.name: record/open/moved-header-new-group
vectors.description: The same signed body re-sealed into another group with the derived salt: cannot be moved.

vectors.name: record/salt-derived
vectors.description: salt = HKDF(ikm = K_epoch, salt = SHA-256(body_without_9), info = "psss/v1/salt"), for the body of record/seal-item.

vectors.name: record/same-body-sealed-twice
vectors.description: The same body sealed twice gives the same sealed record and the same record_id (4.1 deterministic sealing, 4.4 identity).

vectors.name: record/different-body-different-record
vectors.description: A body that differs in one field (the title) gives a different salt, a different sealed record and a different record_id.

vectors.name: record/open/salt-does-not-match-body
vectors.description: A record properly signed (the signature covers the header with the odd salt) but sealed with a salt that is not the derived one: the reader recomputes the salt and discards the record (bad_salt).

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-127-in-body
vectors.description: A body carrying key 127, the largest key that is not an extension key: not an extension key and not defined: the body is malformed.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-127-in-payload
vectors.description: An item payload carrying key 127, the largest key that is not an extension key: not defined: the payload is malformed.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-128-in-body
vectors.description: A body carrying key 128, the smallest extension key: kept and ignored; the signature covers it, and it verifies.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-128-in-payload
vectors.description: An item payload carrying key 128, the smallest extension key: kept and ignored.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-4294967296-in-body
vectors.description: A body carrying key 2^32: kept and ignored; the signature covers it, and it verifies.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-4294967296-in-payload
vectors.description: An item payload carrying key 2^32: kept and ignored.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-18446744073709551615-in-body
vectors.description: A body carrying key 2^64 - 1: kept and ignored; the signature covers it, and it verifies.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-18446744073709551615-in-payload
vectors.description: An item payload carrying key 2^64 - 1: kept and ignored.

vectors.name: record/open/extension-key-value-changed-after-signing
vectors.description: The signed record with the value of extension key 128 changed, the old signature kept and the salt recomputed: the signature no longer verifies (bad_signature), so extension keys are covered by it.

vectors.name: record/open/payload-field-in-set-and-clear
vectors.description: A field named in both set and clear (5.1).

vectors.name: record/open/payload-clear-unsorted
vectors.description: clear = ["aa","b"]: not sorted by encoding (b first); an unsorted array is rejected.

vectors.name: record/open/payload-clear-duplicate
vectors.description: clear = ["a","a"]: not strictly ascending.

vectors.name: record/open/payload-deleted-not-integer

vectors.name: record/open/payload-set-key-not-text
vectors.description: A set map with an integer key.

vectors.name: record/open/unknown-kind-opens
vectors.description: Kind 99 (content, so it carries mhead) passes steps 1 and 2: kept, takes its place in its chain, no other effect (4.3).
